note: Nauru's banking is the Commonwealth Bank of Australia's, since Bendigo Bank left in 2025: the CommBank's own page for Naoero (read 2026-10-30) says CommBank is now servicing the people and businesses of Naoero, following the exit of the existing banking provider and the treaty between the two governments, from two agencies at Aiwo and Ewa, where Nauruans open a CommBank Streamline Basic account and a NetBank Saver. The CommBank's Transaction, Savings and Investment Account Terms and Conditions (the copy with the addendum for Nauruan customers, effective 1 October 2026) say a 'Nauruan Account' is one of these products issued by the Commonwealth Bank of Australia, the Agency in Nauru standing for a branch, the Terms and Conditions otherwise applying in their entirety, and those terms define a customer's account details as including the BSB and the account number. So an account in Nauru is a CommBank account numbered as Australia's are (a BSB and an account number), and the file follows Australia's form. Nauru's own government or financial regulator wasn't read on this; no other bank in Nauru was found.

sources.title: Commonwealth Bank of Australia, CommBank Naoero: How Naoero customers can access banking services with CommBank
sources.said: CommBank, Australia’s largest bank, is now servicing the people and businesses of Naoero. ... Streamline Basic, an everyday account for individual customers, with access to NetBank and Debit Mastercard ... You can visit either the two Agencies at Aiwo District and Ewa District to become a Commbank Customer ... Following the exit of the existing banking provider, and the recent announcement of a Treaty between the Governments of Australia and Nauru, CommBank will establish banking operations in Nauru.

sources.title: Commonwealth Bank of Australia, Transaction, Savings and Investment Account Terms and Conditions, with the Addendum specific to Nauruan customers (effective 1 October 2026)
sources.said: If you create a CommBank Customer profile in Nauru, you will be considered a Nauruan customer. Once opened, your account will be considered a ‘Nauruan Account’. ... Unless otherwise specified in this Addendum, the Terms and Conditions apply to you in their entirety. ... These products are issued by the Commonwealth Bank of Australia ... Means our record of your account containing account details including BSB, account number, account name
